name: Sharks Underwater Grill and Bar
description: An upscale sit-down restaurant with a floor-to-ceiling shark aquarium view. The menu includes filet mignon, cold-water lobster bisque and miso-roasted Atlantic salmon. Priority seating is recommended. Park admission is required and prices here are estimates.

name: Voyager's Smokehouse
description: A hickory-smoked American barbecue place across from the Seaport Theater, with mobile ordering. It serves Texas-style brisket, a smoked rib and chicken sampler and a pulled pork sandwich. Prices here are estimates.

name: Altitude Burgers
description: A burger spot serving handmade smash burgers and grilled chicken, such as the Bacon Bleu Burger, the Rodeo Burger and a crispy Thai chili chicken sandwich. A plant-based burger is also available. Prices here are estimates.

items.name: Bacon Bleu Burger
items.description: Smash burger with bacon and blue cheese

name: Waterway Grill
description: A restaurant with American food and Amazon-region flavors, plus a Waterway Bar with craft beer and indoor seating. Dishes include grilled churrasco steak, sofrito chicken and slow-roasted pork, and mobile ordering is available. Prices here are estimates.
